theorems.name: Submission.varifold_tangents_dlb_restricted_bad_set_weight_le
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (x : Euclidean N) (t R : ℝ) (c : ℝ≥0∞) (W : Varifold N n (ball (0 : Euclidean N) R)) (E O : Set (Euclidean N)), 0 < t → 0 < R → W.measure = c • (rescaledMeasure V x t).restrict (ball (0 : Euclidean N) R ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n))) → O ⊆ ball (0 : Euclidean N) R → W.weight ({y | x + t • y ∈ E} ∩ O) ≤ c * (ENNReal.ofReal R ^ n * (V.weight {z | z ∈ closedBall x (t * R) ∧ z ∈ E} / ENNReal.ofReal (t * R) ^ n))
